tvShow.name: HIS & HERS
tvShow.overview: Two estranged spouses — one a detective, the other a news reporter — vie to solve a murder in which each believes the other is a prime suspect.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: TV newswoman Anna returns to her small Georgia hometown to report on a murder case, in which her estranged husband Jack is the lead investigator.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Jack and Priya try to poke holes in a key suspect's alibi. Anna returns to her alma mater for a contentious interview with an old classmate.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Anna jumps at a chance to return to the anchor desk. Zoe confronts Jack about what he's been hiding. Alice's decline forces some tough conversations.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Jack struggles to placate the locals at a fiery town hall. Priya's suspicions reach a breaking point. Anna is haunted by painful memories.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Backed into a corner, Jack grows increasingly erratic. Anna finds herself on the opposite side of an interview. Richard's past comes to light.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: As the case comes to a close, Jack and Anna must reckon with the sins of the past — and the brutal consequences in the present.

seasons.name: Limited Series
seasons.overview: Reclusive former news anchor Anna Andrews becomes obsessed with a murder case in her hometown. Her estranged husband, Detective Jack Harper, suspicious of her involvement, puts Anna in the crosshairs of his investigation.

reviews.author: jpnusa77
reviews.content:
What a waste of time. I really like Pablo Schreiber, he's a fantastic actor in everything I've seen him in. Jon Bernthal is pretty good too, although I am not always the biggest fan of the shows and movies he picks. 

But I'm sorry but tessa thompson has zero charisma and cannot act at all. I don't get why she is being put into these lead roles. Maybe she would be better suited to a role that is background. Zero chemistry within the cast too. And boring story. Yawn. . .

Bottom line: I would not recommend this show to anyone I know in real life.

reviews.author: moviemovement
reviews.content: Really boring, and the actors do not have good rapport. It seems they just throw any old cast willing to do a show nowadays rather than spending time to find great characters.
